review_description: Very confusing and there isn't much feedback / reviews you can look at to help make a decision. Each installer (we got about 6 quotes) said different things and sometimes contradicted each other.  We didn't want Chinese stuff.  We wanted German quality.  In the end it was a toss-up between two companies. Went with a gut feeling (customer service) and the fact that the installer is certified with a licence - he is a qualified solar installer.
